I’ll trace the software and installation evidence, add an inventory linked from the README, and add maintenance checks. I’ll leave the changes, session record and PR handoff in this worktree for the host publisher.

I’m using the nODD coordination and review skills for the evidence and validation.

The repository already records pinned source dependencies, a node-bound Spack runtime and a separate analysis environment. I’ll distinguish those recorded setups from current runtime availability.

I’ll also add a CI check for new software families, submodules and dependency manifests. A SoftEng agent is checking the historical installation and PR evidence while I build the page and maintenance checks.

The evidence check found two distinctions to preserve: current calorimeter code restores EDM4hep I/O, while digitization and clustering remain explicit skeletons; and the recorded Geant4 versions vary between campaigns. I found no Marlin/LCIO integration evidence at the input revision, so the inventory will mark that status as unknown.

The upkeep check now covers local code families and dependency/build recipes, without activating or changing the native runtime.

The inventory now lists 56 components across 99 local code families, with four pinned software submodules and fingerprints for 51 dependency/build inputs. The 10 new tests pass, including checks for a new undeclared family, changed dependencies, changed pins and a stale generated page.

I’m running the repository checks and finishing the task evidence. The draft PR and its interaction record remain the host publisher’s responsibility once a PR number exists.

`make check` passed the software layout, inventory and session checks, then stopped because project-record validation needs a historical Git commit missing from this worktree (`78bc60bb…`). I’ve recorded that limitation.

I’m running the interaction and token-site checks separately so the final handoff can identify exactly what passed and what remains blocked.

The inventory and upkeep checks are ready for review. Interaction validation and the token-site build passed. The final artifact check found 13 changed text files, 228 valid local inventory links, and no staged changes or new commits.

The remaining validation limit is the missing historical project-record commit. I’ll leave publication to the host with the completed session record, selected request evidence and a structured PR handoff.

Adds a README-linked software inventory covering 56 components and 99 local code families, with keywords, integration/install evidence, recorded versions and related PRs. Adds CI and make checks for coverage, dependency inputs, source pins and page freshness. Updates contributor instructions and records the curated session and request evidence.

Validation: 10 inventory tests pass; inventory, session, interaction and token validators pass; token-site build passes; 228 local inventory links resolve.

Blocker: `make check` stops at existing project records referencing unavailable historical commit `78bc60bb6da0c9d234baf00d37cadea9dd4964b4`. Earlier layout, inventory and session checks pass.

Versions reflect historical evidence; no native runtime or installation was exercised. Exact token counters are unavailable. No detector changes, commits or remote writes were made. Host publication and the numbered PR interaction record remain pending; human review is required."
